# **\--Isekai History--**

Nari gels are the quickest and safest way to perform actions on any living soul, as they are ready to be consumed or injected, and their tiered effects are easy to reproduce. Ground nari dust is infused with water to create a jelly-like consistency, which you then mix with other substances and possibly catalysts to achieve any desired effect. The coarser, cheaper grades of nari gels are easier to consume, but their transformative effects tend to be more painful and slower to take effect. You can pay a premium for very fine-grade nari gels that make it easier to inject, especially if you want to reduce the pain as much as possible.

A wide range of nari gels fulfills most poisons, body, and mental status modifications. From changing your eyeballs to the same as someone else who has better vision than you to completely transforming yourself into a Big Winga so that you can soar the skies freely\! The fact that they are tiered means the difference between smoothing your skin versus melting it off as you suffer the worst imaginable pain and scream to someone to end your life can be just three scoops away from one another.

On the plus side, your liver will eventually process and expel the nari gel changes, so if you are solo and put yourself in jeopardy, sit back and relax\! If you don’t die from it, you will eventually be able to get back up and do it again\! On average, the coarser, cheaper stuff tends to take longer to be expelled, so keep this in mind. Either way, do it enough times; your body might start to accept the changes as a new reality, changing your meaning of normal forever.  It won’t be cheap unless you get high on your nari gels.

Scientists, usually alongside businesspeople, try to outperform each other with the latest and most extraordinary recipes. Unfortunately, this market has gained a reputation for being cutthroat. Sometimes, the neck-breaking research speed or shady cost-cutting in testing can lead to unaware buyers being “alpha-testers“ of new products and their claims.

​

Everyone buys these gels, with adventurers usually buying more than commoners. A wise adventurer will always have a nari refresher ready to be consumed to reset all afflictions caused by other nari gels—unless said adventurer is using fake body nari gels to alter their personality, which is not unheard of, but definitely not recommended.

* **Tier I (Cheap Goods)**  
  * **None**  
* **Tier II (Common Goods)**  
  * **None**  
* **Tier III (Expensive Goods)**  
  * **Nari Gels**  
* **Tier IV (Nobility Goods)**  
  * **Banned Nari Gels**  
  * **The coarser, cheaper grades of nari gels are easier to consume, but their transformative effects tend to be more painful and slower to take effect. You can pay a premium for very fine-grade nari gels that make it easier to inject, especially if you want to reduce the pain as much as possible.**  
    * **On average, the coarser, cheaper stuff tends to take longer to be expelled, so keep this in mind.**

# **\--Sustained Soul Consumption--**

**Do note that there is no upfront Soul cost, as the Soul energy required for action is contained within the gel itself.**

* **Tier I Avg (Cosmetic)**  
  * **\~1 Nari Soul/Day**  
* **Tier II Avg (Localized)**  
  * **\~2 Nari Soul/Day**  
* **Tier III Avg (Regional)**  
  * **\~4 Nari Soul/Day**  
* **Tier IV Avg (Whole Body)**  
  * **\~8 Nari Soul/Day**

## **Bleed Out**

**![image.png][image1]**

**​**

* **Website Description**  
  * **Made from ground Nari, dried Panita mushrooms, and Bagarisa blood. Effects range from blood thinner to bleeding from the ears and eyes (usually used for a good prank or theater plays) to full-blow hemorrhage. Many subversions exist, such as controlling the victim's heart rate.**  
* **Isekai History**  
  * **Made from ground Nari, dried Panita mushrooms, and Bagarisa blood to enhance the effect.**  
* **Inventor**  
  * **Hunters at some point during B.G.**  
* **Subversions**  
  * **How quickly targets bleed out, or additional effects such as slowing the heart rate.**  
* **Usage**  
  * **Tier I (Cosmetic): Blood thinner**  
  * **Tier II (Localized): Injuries won’t stop bleeding**  
  * **Tier III (Regional): Bleeding from nose, eyes, ears, etc.**  
  * **Tier IV (Whole Body): Internal Hemorrhage. Death**  
* **Cost**  
  * **30\~60 Pearls for \~200g**

## **Water Breath**

**![image.png][image10]**

* **Website Description**  
  * **This one is pretty straightforward. Fish gills mixed with ground nari and water, and there you go\! You can breathe underwater\! Well, it's more complex, actually. Depending on the quality of the nari gel, gills may develop on the back near the lungs or on the sides of the neck, which can affect efficiency. Tier I (Cosmetic) usually results in Malformed gills in the person slurping this gel, causing them to be unable to breathe air or water properly or eat properly. Tier II (Localized) does come with better water breathing. The skin might become slightly scaly, and the person must swim to breathe underwater, no longer able to breathe air. Some custom versions figured out a way to still allow people to breathe air, though expect to pay top dollar for it. Meanwhile, Tier III (Regional) gives you far more efficient water breathing while costing you any remaining air-breathing, with some versions allowing you to eat again. Some nari gels worsen scaly skin or give core temperature regulation issues, while other variants will enable you to stand still while the gills and other structures pump the water through. Tier IV (Whole Body) typically allows one to breathe even in swampy, less oxygenated water, but you might become more fish than human... In other words, your breath goes glub glub.**  
* **Isekai History**  
  * **Made from ground Nari with Fish gills mixed with seawater.**  
* **Inventor**  
  * **Hunters at some point during B.G.**  
* **Subversions**  
  * **Whether the person can still speak, or how long they can stay underwater. Make skin carry oxygen as well (which might give a min or two if the person pairs up with Time Slown.)**  
* **Usage**  
  * **Gills develop on the back near the lungs, that is, if the Nari gel is of good quality.**  
  * **Tier I (Cosmetic): Malformed gills on a person. Unable to properly breathe air or water. Unable to eat properly either.**  
  * **Tier II (Localized): Better water breathing. Unable to eat. Skin might become slightly scaly. Must swim to breath. Unable to breath air**  
  * **Tier III (Regional): Perfect water breathing. Scaly skin as a side effect. Can stay still and waterbreath. Unable to breathe air. The person has to keep swimming to breathe.**  
  * **Tier IV (Whole Body): A person can breathe while standing still in water. Can breathe in less oxygenated water.**  
* **Cost**  
  * **35\~105 Pearls for \~200g**

    

## **Winga Flight**

Then slurp a "tasty" Winga Flight potion and see your bones lighten up, your fat and flesh transform into pure muscles, and all of your hair transform into beautiful feathers the more you drink it. Please don't drink too much, or you will get a beak\! Your vocal cords will also change to allow you to sing at notes you never imagined you could do before, though at the cost of enunciating the Vraki language becoming an indistinguishable mess. If you keep drinking it, you could develop issues processing higher thoughts, as your physical brain will reduce in size as well. On the plus side, you can't worry about stuff if you're a literal birdbrain. It is not unheard of for people to give up on everything and become a cute Winga, but the longer you stay as a Winga, the more your soul will get corrupted, and with enough years, you will be unable to return to what you once knew yourself as.**  
* **Isekai History**  
  * **Made from ground Nari with several body parts from Winga.**  
* **Inventor**  
  * **Hunters at some point during B.G.**  
* **Subversions**  
  * **Colors, wing length, takeoff weight, etc.**  
* **Usage**  
  * **Tier I (Cosmetic): Lighter bones, feathers on skin, Arms decrease in thickness, forelimbs extend to twice the length, thighs decrease in girth, weaker lower body.**  
  * **Tier II (Localized): flying feathers grow from arms and forearms; arms reshape into wings. The lower body transforms into bird legs.  Gliding/flying is possible except for fat people.**  
  * **Tier III (Regional): Further body reshape to a winga. Beaks form while speech capability is reduced to a Winga, but the person can fly faster/longer.**  
  * **Tier IV (Whole Body): Further body reshape to a winga. Beaks form while speech capability is reduced to a Winga.**  
* **Cost**  
  * **35\~55 Pearls for \~200g**

  * **Tier II (Localized): Same, but more. Ears begin showing fur and a slight change in shape.**

## **Monika Sight**

**![image.png][image20]\*Similar-ish. Remove gills and add cut-up Monika.**

  * **?**

  * **A.G. Scientists Named ?**  
* **Subversions**  
  * **How good the perception is, how well the brain adapts to it, what the enhanced volatile compound is, etc.**

  * **Tier II (Localized): Desired volatile compounds begin to appear as sparkles in the vision, with father distances being calculated by the brain. There’s usually a delay in the vision.**  
  * **Tier III (Regional): Full effect. The number of artifacts in the vision can be overwhelming for some, to the point that they can only use it with their eyes closed. Can cause nosebleeds in some people, migraines, or a general feeling unwell because of how taxing the calculation is on the brain.**  
  * **Tier IV (Whole Body): Overdriving effect. Most collapses are caused by overwhelming input sensations and the brain's calculations.**

## **No Breath**

**![image.png][image21]\*Similar-ish. No hair, and nose pieces. Add gills & chopped lungs, and chopped Lakata.**

* **Website Description**  
  * **?**  
* **Isekai History**  
  * **Made from ground Nari with Lakata, Fihi gills, and Barina lungs. Used for Stealth.**  
* **Inventor**  
  * **Fisherman a long time ago.**  
* **Subversions**  
  * **How long does it last? The urge to breathe, etc.**  
* **Usage**  
  * **Tier I (Cosmetic): Can hold breath for slightly longer, but will pass out as this basically removes the restriction from the brain trying to make you breath air.**  
    * **\~1min**  
  * **Tier II (Localized): Bumps in the neck, gills-like flaps appear.  Respiration occurs primarily through the lungs when a person has their mouth closed. Then breathe underwater by opening the mouth and letting water pass through the gills, but eventually they need to breathe air again as the gills are not powerful enough. Their automated respiration mechanism stops working, so they have to breathe manually—through a conscious effort.**  
    * **\*Each side of Harry’s neck developed a large bony plate that looked to be protecting something within, only revealing a deep cut around its edges—just like the operculum of a fish gill.**  
    * **Speech is no longer possible.**  
    * **\~6mins**  
  * **Tier III (Regional): Additional bumps in the back gills-like flap appear. Breathing takes air in through the mouth, and exhales through the gills-like flap in the neck and upper back. The person can breathe fully underwater, but not in air.**  
    * **Speech is no longer possible.**  
    * **\~20mins**  
  * **Tier IV (Whole Body): Full conversion. Cannot breath air.**  
* **Cost**  
  * **55\~75 Pearls for \~200g**

## **Moist Breath**

**![image.png][image22]**

* **Website Description**  
  * **?**  
* **Isekai History**  
  * **Made from ground Nari, Lakata, and worms. Used for Stealth.**  
    * **In regards to Hair: In some ways, it would make it more realistic to have Harry lose his hair because of the skin transformation, but at the same time, I can scientifically explain it away that the Nari gel is altering the Dermis of the skin, and the removal of hair is not a dominant gene, so the hair remains as a vestigial human feature.**  
* **Inventor**  
  * **Eori on 1039 A.G.**  
* **Subversions**  
  * **How long does it last? The urge to breathe, etc.**  
* **Usage**  
  * **Tier I (Cosmetic): reddish skin.**  
    * **\~1min**  
  * **Tier II (Localized):  Urge to breath is removed. Skin gets slightly slimy. Skin is extra sensitive.**  
  * **Tier III (Regional):  Skin is extra sensitive and slimy as it becomes loose, but the person no longer has to breath as much. Breathing is slightly cumbersome. The person gets cold a bit quicker.**  
  * **![image.png][image23]**  
    * **\~20mins**  
  * **Tier IV (Whole Body): a lot of folds. Skin becomes irritated. Moving becomes harder, and the moistness will make noises that remove the benefit of not breathing. The sagging skin hurts, and breath is hard and noisy as the inside of the mouth and throat gets saggy too. Body heat is lost at a higher rate.**

## **Sore Mind**

**![image.png][image32]\*Similar-ish. Replace with Sorefaries amygdalas and brain matter ![image.png][image33]**

* **Website Description**  
  * **?**  
* **Isekai History**  
  * **Used to treat depression and some other brain disorders. Effects are spotty at best, but some people were cured by it.**  
  * **Some use it as a drug to cause an exhilarated, childish feeling. Forway is on the fence about banning it.**  
* **Inventor**  
  * **? on 1017 A.G.**  
* **Subversions**  
  * **Picking from a sorefaries with milder manners versus another sorefaries with even more intense emotions. Usually, each crafted gel is unique since even within a series, their mind change over time.**  
* **Usage**  
  * **Tier I (Cosmetic): A high feeling, like exhilaration. Like drinking two beers.**  
    * **\~1min**  
  * **Tier II (Localized):  The effect grows more prominent. Handling the feelings can be quite hard for some, as their intensity might be greater than anything they have ever felt.**  
  * **Tier III (Regional):  Most people have a very bad trip on this level. Often, the emotions spiral out of control to the point that the person's self-awareness can grow insane or self-detach. Split personality can happen too, or have similar emotions and fears as the sorefaries you grabbed the amygdala from.**  
  * **Tier IV (Whole Body): If you somehow don’t go insane, then most likely you create a split personality or change your personality that can linger for quite a while after the effect is reset with Nari refresher.**  
* **Cost**  
  * **450\~750 Pearls for \~200g**
